to generate ACTN2-BirA* knock-in iPSCs

labeled with respective first 9 of a 10-plex tandem mass tag (TMT) reagent

static alkylation of cysteine (57.02146 Da), static TMT labeling of lysine residues and N-termini of peptides (229.162932 Da), and variable oxidation of methionine (15.99491 Da)
For BioID studies, Actinin-BirA* and control non-BirA* iPSC-CMs were treated with 50 μM biotin for 24 hours
we subjected both biotin-pulsed Actinin-BirA* and control non-BirA* iPSC-CM lysates to streptavidin immunoprecipitation followed by tandem mass tag (TMT) quantitative proteomics

Cleared lysate were added to magnetic Dynabeads MyOne Streptavidin C1 beads (Invitrogen 65001), which were prewashed with PBS and lysis buffer. Immunoprecipitation was performed on a rotator overnight at 4°C.
